name: media_none
concern: Instructions reserve none for ordinary NOTE/PERSON/GOAL/IDEA facts; validator accepts a media none action.

name: book_listen
concern: Instructions reserve listen for music playback; validator accepts BOOK/listen.

name: mixed_missing_action
concern: A mixed note can contain a known event plus an unknown action, but top-level MIXED/mixed cannot carry missing_action because that reason requires intent null.
validatorError: An unknown action cannot also be known

name: unresolved_reference_none
concern: The policy examples use null for context-free unresolved it/that; the validator accepts none with unresolved_reference.
